title: Chapter 691
paragraphs: Chapter 691
Episode 176. Destiny for Two People (5)
"But, didn't you say you were crippled due to long-term torture? How did you survive from Rosa?"
"Did your body ever change in an instant, 12th trainee?"
"I felt stronger every time I reached a new level."
"I'm not just talking about that kind of realm, I felt like I was reborn completely."
"I have seen it. Through the late Master Ron."

"I experienced it firsthand the moment I decided to live for the young lady. My body, which could not do anything without Numerus's divine power, suddenly began to come alive. I felt my broken and misaligned bones mending, and my damaged organs recovering."
Just like Ron had resurrected alone from death when he confronted Gliac, Hedo also experienced the reforming of his body.
"I even wondered for a moment if I had entered the same realm as Master Shiron. I soon realized it was just a delusion, but it was enough for me to fight."
"That day, you and Sandra protected each other."

"We were pushed back because we fought without adapting to the new level and didn't have a decent sword, but fortunately, Rosa was also tired from penetrating to the experiment room. Thanks to that, we held out until the support from the main unit arrived, and Rosa escaped gnashing her teeth."
Afterwards, Hedo naturally joined Ziffel.
He had only two requests to Kelliak. To return his sword obtained from the Black Sea, and to live with Sandra.
Sandra gave Hedo something that no one else had given him.
The meaning of living a life. Neither the orphanage director, the knight he first killed, Shiron, Kelliak, nor anyone else or anything had given him that.
"So, you became the second housekeeper."

"There was no more suitable position. Since then, I learned many things to serve the young lady. Common sense and knowledge of the world, culture, etc. I started learning what the young lady was lacking the most. Since she was no different from a beast, I thought I should teach her."
For Sandra, Hedo absorbed everything insanely quickly.
What he learned fastest was how to deal with the family. He soon realized that the family coveted his loyalty, but also confirmed that there were many who were suspicious.

So he volunteered to be a cleaner. He ruthlessly eliminated those who stayed in their positions causing problems like this time, and cleaned up the factions in the family that wasted their energy on meaningless power struggles. Using his overwhelming force.
He didn't have excessive ambitions, so it was only natural that the leaders, including Kelliak, were satisfied with him.
In no time, Hedo became the hidden power of Ziffel. He didn't change his position even after he became the real power because there was no need to.
However, the only reward he wished for has not been fulfilled to this day.

"To treat Lady Sandra as a human, not an experimental subject, and to give her freedom. That's all I wanted from the family. I have never demanded it openly after taking power, but the family knew it clearly."
"Ziffel would never have allowed that. They would have thought your loyalty would disappear the moment Sandra gained freedom."

"It's true that the family didn't want to let go of the leash, but it wasn't just that. I also thought that the family was the most helpful for the young lady's safety. The long-standing grudge between the family and Runkandel, international politics, and the strange temperament of the young lady that just won't change were the reasons. Can she lead a normal life after leaving the family?"
Kelliak
was waiting for the day when Hedo would pledge his real loyalty to the family, not to Sandra.
"… I was in the process of creating a domain for me and the young lady within the family using that fact, 12th trainee."
"From your perspective, it looks like things went wrong because of me…….”
There was silence for a while, and Jin suddenly thought of Sandra from his previous life. She had had a strategic marriage with a lower-ranking royal family of the Bement Empire.
Perhaps, Sandra's marriage back then might have been the result of Hedo's will finally bearing fruit.
As if frightened by the thought, Hedo opened his mouth again and uttered these words.

"12th trainee. What I wanted to give the young lady as a reward was a normal life. Having a normal personality, mingling with others, someday meeting a decent partner and spending the rest of her life with them. If it weren't for you…… I would have definitely made that happen."
Jin didn't answer and met Hedo's gaze.
"But that was what I wanted, not the life the young lady wanted…… I finally realize such an easy thing now."
Hedo poured the last remaining drink into his and Jin's glasses.
"Tower Keeper, I have a question."
"What is it?"

"It seems that even after you took control, Ziffel didn't stop experimenting through Sandra, and you said that it was what Sandra wanted. In my opinion, that was a choice for you. I called you a coward without knowing the circumstances, but I'd like to take that back."
"There's no need for that because it was true that I was a coward."

Sandra's participation in the experiment was of course because she wanted to help Hedo. She thought she occasionally needed to show a docile side so that Hedo would be less suspected, and that if she obtained the semi-immortal body, Hedo would be in less trouble.
"12th trainee."
"Speak."
"Honestly, I'm still skeptical. Even if the young lady and I were to become your family here, I wonder if it would really be better than the relatively stable days we had in the family so far."
"What do you want to do?"

"I'm not saying that I want to go back to the family. Looking back, it was always a life of constantly moving from one place of refuge to another. The life in the family was not a good time for either of us in the end."
"I guess I should change the question. What can I do for you?"
"One day, if I think there's no hope in Tikhan, I won't hesitate to leave with the young lady. Don't block me then."
"I swear. Not only will I not stop you, but there will also be no act of retaliation, hunting you down claiming you and Sandra betrayed us."
"I wonder if I can trust your word."
"Am I not a person of that caliber now? And above all……"
Jin turned around and looked at Sandra for a moment.
Tikhan must be a better choice than her previous life when she married a royal, Jin thought.
Even if she got married back then, Ziffel existed, so Sandra would have been under surveillance, and there was a high chance she was used politically.
Besides, Sandra back then didn't act as crazily as now, so it could have been a result of mental manipulation.
It was Jin's duty to make her freer than that.

"I feel a significant debt to Sandra. She has helped me several times and even saved my life. Right now, dealing with Rosa is the priority, but my ultimate goal includes the downfall of Zipfel. Once they're gone, there will be no threats for you and Sandra in the world."
"The time of our departure may be sooner than the final battle with Hyungshin."

"I understand. After all, even if I try to scare you, it won't affect you. Losing power is painful, but as for me, I have to respect it. If you were the type to succumb to power, it would be a different story."
Hedo's pipe smoke faded, leaving the ember.
"But I sincerely plan to prevent such a thing. I will help to end the long nightmare of you and Sandra during our stay in Tikan."
As Jin quietly looked down at his glass, Hedo picked up his glass.
It was their first toast. Hedo and Sandra would now stay in Tikan.
"Suddenly, I remember something you said a while ago."
-"You might be the descendant of the ten knights called Veil. So the sword found you. It's not a coincidence."
The words Jin had said to persuade Hedo.
Of course, Hedo is not a descendant of Veil. But there were definitely uncanny similarities in the destinies of Hedo and Veil.

"As I spoke with you, I thought of the story of Lord Veil. The things he experienced were not as cruel as yours, but just as you were reborn through Sandra, Lord Veil also found the meaning of existence from Lady Sara."
Just as Jin had heard Hedo's past, he had already had some conversation with Veil.
Veil was just a monster causing destruction everywhere before he met Sara, just like Hedo.
"That madman seems to have no thought, unlike me. I still don't believe in fate, but I have to admit that your words fit well."
Jin smiled.
"I would like to believe this is fate for the two of us."
Hedo shrugged his shoulders and lit a new pipe.
"More than that, the thing you first asked for is the problem. Now that I and the lady have become traitors, we can't help finding your sister Yona Lunkandel in Akin."

"Well, since you and Veil have joined Tikan, the situation is actually better. You, me, and Lord Veil. If these three of us infiltrate Akin directly and cooperate with Moomyeong, we can sufficiently and quickly suppress my rampaging sister Yona, even without Zipfel's help."
"Infiltrating the family territory right after betrayal, you give such a brazen task."
"If it's a burden, I'll just take Lord Veil."
"No, I'll go with you. While I'm there, I need to secure your sister and leave a message to the family."
"Thank you, tower keeper. Oh, and."
Jin offered a handshake to Hedo. Hedo looked at the hand for a few seconds, then shook it.
"From now on, I will use honorifics and manners. Please forget my rudeness due to the special circumstances so far, Lord Hedo."
Hedo liked Jin's words subtly and replied like this.
"Then I'll let my words go easy, 12th rank. I look forward to working with you."
Then Hedo turned his head to the pillar on the side.
"And, I trust Miss Valeria as well. Let me tell you one thing... the lady has never been involved in anything related to Hister."
When Jin and Hedo first entered the restaurant, Valeria appeared from behind the pillar.
Jin and Hedo knew from
the start that she was listening to their conversation from there, and Valeria did too, but they didn't show it to each other.
Valeria leaned on the railing for a while and looked up at the sky.
